novel_features.name: Inbox workload overview
novel_features.description: One-command summary of open conversations, unassigned contacts, per-agent distribution, and recent activity.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join across contacts, assignees, and status that no single API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use instead of a dozen API calls when you need the current inbox load at a glance.

novel_features.name: Channel mix report
novel_features.description: See which messaging channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, email...) your contacts actually use.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates channel sources across all synced contacts in SQLite, which the live API does not precompute.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answer 'where do our customers talk to us' instantly from local data.

novel_features.name: Workload by agent
novel_features.description: Per-agent message and conversation handling volume from the synced workspace.
novel_features.rationale: Correlates space users with assigned contacts in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Balance the team and spot overloaded agents without manual tallying.

novel_features.name: Tag cohort segments
novel_features.description: List every contact that carries a given tag (VIP, unpaid, in-trial).
novel_features.rationale: Filters the local mirror for a tag cohort the API cannot return in one call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pull a whole segment for campaigns or support outreach in one command.

novel_features.name: Custom-field gaps
novel_features.description: Find contacts missing a custom field value (e.g. no orderId or region).
novel_features.rationale: Queries the local store for contacts without a given field populated.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Spot data quality gaps to drive clean-up or re-enrichment.

novel_features.name: Idle follow-up
novel_features.description: Find unassigned contacts with no recent activity worth working.
novel_features.rationale: Time-windowed scan over the local mirror for routing follow-up.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Route idle work before it goes cold.

novel_features.name: Offline contact search
novel_features.description: Free-text search across synced contacts without hitting the API.
novel_features.rationale: Uses SQLite FTS5 over the local contact mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find a customer by name/email offline, fast, without api.respond.io.

narrative.headline: Every Respond.io feature, plus an offline mirror and SQL that answers inbox questions no single API call can.
narrative.value_prop: respondio-pp-cli wraps the full Respond.io Unification API v2 - contacts, messaging, conversations, comments, and workspace - then syncs contacts, users, and channels into a local SQLite store. Offline you can segment by tag, find custom-field gaps, check channel mix, and gauge workload by agent with --json output built for agents.
narrative.auth_narrative: Auth uses a Respond.io API access token (Settings > Integrations > Developer API). Set RESPOND_IO_API_TOKEN and run respondio-pp-cli auth login. All commands are read-mostly; mutations support --dry-run.

quickstart.comment: Check token, config, and API reachability (works without live auth).
Look up a contact by identifier (id:, email:, phone:).
Mirror contacts and workspace into the local database.
Search contacts offline in the local mirror.
Pull a tag cohort from local data.

troubleshoots.fix: Confirm RESPOND_IO_API_TOKEN is set and valid via 'respondio-pp-cli doctor'.
The CLI respects X-RateLimit headers and retries with backoff; narrow with --resources and --limit.
Run 'respondio-pp-cli sync' first - novel reports read the local mirror, not the live API.

narrative.when_to_use: Use respondio-pp-cli for Respond.io support/sales operations: looking up contacts, sending messages, routing and assigning conversations, and answering inbox questions offline (channel mix, tag cohorts, custom-field gaps, workload by agent). It is the right choice when you want agent-native --json output and a local mirror instead of one-off API calls.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for deep Respond.io analytics that need historical message-by-message mining (the mirror is a snapshot).
Do not use it to configure Respond.io workspace settings outside the exposed endpoints.
Do not use it as a replacement for the Respond.io web product for manual conversation handling.
